description: Futures positioning screen (CFTC COT) — One-call positioning screen across 43 major futures markets (metals, energy, equity indexes, Treasuries/SOFR, FX, CME bitcoin/ether, grains, softs, livestock) from the latest CFTC Commitments of Traders report: large-speculator net, weekly change, % of open interest and a 0-100 COT index vs the lookback range, sorted from most crowded long to most crowded short, with crowdedLong/crowdedShort lists and the biggest weekly shifts. group = all, metals, energy, equities, rates, fx, crypto, grains, softs or livestock; optional years=1-5 lookback (default 3). U.S. government public-domain data. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_cot_screen
